newsitem.title: USA: Exxon sued for low pay by former employee.
newsitem.headline: Exxon sued for low pay by former employee.

text.p: Exxon Corp and other unnamed chemical companies have been sued by a former Exxon employee, Roberta Todd, for conspiracy to reduce the salaries of non-union employees, said a class action complaint filed in New York.

Todd alleges in her complaint that Exxon Chemical Co, a unit of Exxon Corp, and other chemical companies exchange information concerning the salaries of non-union employees which has reduced competitition in the industry.
Todd further alleges that as a result of this exchange of information, each conspiring company paid lower salaries to its non-union employees than they would have had to pay.
Todd's attorney said he believes the other unnamed conspiring chemical companies will be identified through the discovery process.
Todd is suing on behalf of herself and other non-union, salaried employees for lost wages, punitive damages and an injunction to prevent the chemical companies from further conspiring.
Exxon said it is unaware of the lawsuit and could not comment on it.
